# Authored structural fixtures

These short ASS/SRT subtitles were written for this project; they are not copied
from an anime. They exercise unsorted times, multiline dialogue, English/Persian
mixing, Japanese honorifics, quote scope, a credit beside ordinary dialogue about a
translator, empty events, hidden comments, a reset-only style, an unused style,
vector drawings and a complementary SRT sign. Tests supply explicit editorial
decisions rather than pretending to evaluate translation intelligence.

The temporary font block in the mechanical preservation check is synthetic and
does not establish embedded-font rendering quality. FFmpeg integration uses
installed fonts. Actual anime meaning, full-season consistency, matching-video
sync and application-specific playback need real user inputs.
